│                                                                             │
│  Time Complexity:                                                          │
│  • get():    O(n) where n = cache size                                     │
│  • put():    O(n) where n = cache size                                     │
│  • remove(): O(n) where n = cache size                                     │
│  • Suitable for: Up to 10,000 entries typically                            │

│  • Read-heavy workload:  Minimal contention ✅                             │

┌─ QUICK START GUIDE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                             │
│  1. COPY SOURCE FILES                                                      │
│     cp src/CacheEntry.java your/project/                                  │
│     cp src/CacheManager.java your/project/                                │
│                                                                             │
│  2. INITIALIZE CACHE                                                       │
│     CacheManager<String> cache = new CacheManager<>(1000);                │
│                                                                             │
│  3. USE IN YOUR CODE                                                       │
│     cache.setCacheEntry("key", "value", 3600);                            │
│     CacheEntry<String> entry = cache.getCacheEntry("key");               │
│                                                                             │
│  4. MONITOR METRICS                                                        │
│     cache.printCacheStats();                                              │
